 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The New Orleans Pelicans have had a few days to decompress and reflect after their frustrating start to the season. Now they head back to the court against the team they just blew a 23-point lead to: the Denver Nuggets .
 The Pelicans sit at 0-3 to start the season, which is not the beginning that anyone on the team believes they should have. They have had a real chance to win all three, but have just not been good enough down the stretch. If they can tighten up in the clutch, they've already proven that they can compete with this team.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Nuggets have played another game since their last meeting, and that was a loss to the Golden State Warriors. Denver is now 1-2, which means both of these teams will probably have a chip on their shoulder in this game. It should make for an entertaining game.

 What To Watch for in New Orleans Pelicans vs. Denver Nuggets
 Did they make any changes over the short break? 
 Jamahl Mosley has already said he's looking at this team in five-game samples, but they just had three losses with a lot of recurring issues. They had three days off to reset, with a chance to look at this team without immediately moving on to the next game. Will they still start Jeremiah Fears despite the struggles? Will Saddiq Bey come in earlier for clutch minutes? Will Herb Jones play more than 17 minutes? It'll be interesting to see the answers of all of those questions and more.
